# orion backup

Saved revisions of a canvas

```sh
orion backup <command> [options]
```

## orion backup list

List saved Orion data revisions

```sh
orion backup list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion backup restore

Restore a saved revision as a new revision

```sh
orion backup restore [revision] [options]
```

| Argument     | Description         |
| ------------ | ------------------- |
| `[revision]` | Revision to restore |
